created_prompt: I create cooking videos online and have 1.2 million followers. My focus is healthy recipes that are quick and easy to make. I'd like you to create a 3-year step-by-step concrete plan for me in order to help me gain even more followers, and to publish a cookbook within the coming 3 years. I haven't decided yet whether to use traditional publishing or self-publishing for the cookbook, so please account for both options within the 3-year plan since I might go either way on that. I do have a limited budget, and cannot afford to commit 4 days per week to my work, so please take that into account as well.
